capex: So this is actually catering to 30% to 40% capacity of our own backward integration.

risks: As a disclaimer, I would like to inform all of you that this call may contain forward-looking statements which may involve risk and uncertainties.

focus: And as a company, we have in-house design team, in-house customer support, manufacturing team, and a lot of new developments are continuously going to cater new market demand across the industry.
